name: Adolph Nordberg
role: Agent selling the Richardton (double R) herd
bio: Adolph Nordberg of Richardton, Dakota, appeared only as the agent in advertisements offering the Richardton (double R) herd for sale. The ads ran from July to September 1886 and listed Hereford bulls, cows, young stock and calves.
